group.name: Which SexLab Framework do you run?

plugin.name: SexLab Framework P+ (2.x)
plugin.description:
Default. For SexLab Framework P+ 2.17 or newer (the SLPP fork with SexLab Scene Builder and node-collision physics).
This build uses the full feature set: per-stage/per-position scene annotations, measured thrust-speed intensity (the F/S label prefix), physics-driven contact SFX, and SLSB climax annotations.
Requires: SexLab Framework P+ 2.17+.

plugin.name: SexLab Framework SE 1.63 (classic) + SLSO
plugin.description:
For classic SexLab Framework SE 1.63. Installs the classic script set, which replaces the six framework-facing scripts.
THIS OPTION HAS TWO EXTRA HARD REQUIREMENTS:
1. SexLab Separate Orgasm (SLSO). Classic SexLab only fires a per-thread orgasm event; SLSO republishes the per-actor event that SLO VE's voice, expressions, SFX and milk triggers all key off. Let SLSO overwrite SexLab - its sslActorAlias override is what emits that event.
2. SLATE plus a Hentairim-convention tag database (e.g. "Hentairim tags.json" in SKSE\Plugins\SLATE). SLATE applies the per-stage/per-position label codes (1ASVP, 5BENI, ...) as SexLab animation tags, and those tags ARE the label engine on classic. Without a tag database every label falls back to lead-in and you will hear only generic behaviour.
With both installed, label fidelity matches the P+ build. The one genuine difference is that classic has no node-collision physics, so physics-driven contact SFX and the adaptive-velocity search are disabled (tag- and timer-driven body SFX work normally), and the fast/slow intensity prefix comes from the authored tag rather than measured thrust speed.
Install order: SexLab 1.63 - SLSO - SLATE + tags - AudioUtil - voice packs - SLO VE last.

plugin.name: Silence contact SFX (for PPA users)
plugin.description:
Check this ONLY if you run PPA (Accurate Penetration). PPA plays its own physics-driven thrust audio, so without this option you hear doubled contact sounds - SLO VE's clap/slushing/impact/blowjob SFX on top of PPA's.
This option overrides those ten SFX folders (blowjob, FastClap, HeavySlushing, Impact, LightSlushing, MediumClap, MediumSlushing, RapidSlushing, SlowClap, WetSlush) with silent files of identical length, leaving everything PPA does NOT cover - kissing, ejaculation, gape and all voices - fully audible.
Leave unchecked if you do not use PPA, or you will lose all contact SFX.
Based on the silent-SFX replacer approach by DuskWanderer.

plugin.name: UBE tongue support
plugin.description:
Check this ONLY if you use UBE 2.0 (Ultimate Body Enhancer) and its custom races (UBE_AllRace.esp).
UBE turns its bodies into separate custom races. A worn item only renders on the races listed in its Armor Addon, and SLO VE's tongue armatures list the vanilla / DLC races only - so on a UBE character the equipped tongue is INVISIBLE (equip succeeds, nothing shows).
This option installs SLOVE_UBE_Support.esp, an override-only (ESL-flagged) patch that adds all 18 UBE races (Breton/Imperial/Nord/Redguard/Dark Elf/ High Elf/Wood Elf/Orc, their vampire variants, plus 2 custom races) to the 10 tongue Armor Addons, so the tongue renders on UBE actors. It reuses the existing tongue meshes - the tongue is head-attached, not body-shaped, so no UBE mesh conversion is needed.
REQUIRES UBE_AllRace.esp (from UBE 2.0). Load SLOVE_UBE_Support.esp AFTER both SLOVE.esp and UBE_AllRace.esp. Leave unchecked if you do not run UBE - it does nothing without the UBE race plugin and its master will be missing.
